```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidypopgen)
library(tidygenclust)
library(resrepo)
library(ggplot2)

# Set cores
n_cores <- 10
data.table::setDTthreads(n_cores)
bigparallelr::set_blas_ncores(n_cores)
```


```{r set-directories}
res_dir <- "../results/s05_fastmixture/s05_b_fastmixture_africa/"
```

# Load data

```{r}
NEO_full <- gt_load("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/NEO_full.gt", 
                    reattach_to = "../data/intermediate/rbind_data/NEO_full")
```

# QC

## Filter Loci

```{r}
NEO_full <- NEO_full %>% group_by(population)
loci_report_m <- qc_report_loci(NEO_full)
NEO_full <- NEO_full %>% ungroup()

# filter loci
to_keep <- which(loci_report_m$hwe_p > 0.01)
NEO_full <- NEO_full %>% select_loci(all_of(to_keep))
count_loci(NEO_full)
NEO_full <-
  NEO_full %>% select_loci_if(loci_missingness(genotypes) < 0.05)
count_loci(NEO_full)
NEO_full <-
  NEO_full %>% select_loci_if(loci_maf(genotypes) > 0.025)
count_loci(NEO_full)
```

## Filter Individuals

```{r eval = FALSE}
NEO_full <-
  NEO_full %>% filter(indiv_missingness(genotypes) < 0.1)

# temporarily remove all populations with only one individual before relatedness QC
pop_tbl <- table(NEO_full$population)
to_remove <- which(pop_tbl == 1)
to_remove_pops <- names(to_remove)
removed_pops <- NEO_full %>%
  filter(population %in% to_remove_pops)
NEO_full <-
  NEO_full %>% filter(!population %in% to_remove_pops)

# remove relatives
NEO_full <- NEO_full %>% group_by(population)
individual_report_m <-
  qc_report_indiv(NEO_full, kings_threshold = 0.0884)
NEO_full <- NEO_full %>% ungroup()
NEO_full <-
  NEO_full %>% filter(id %in% individual_report_m$id & individual_report_m$to_keep == TRUE)

# bind data together again
NEO_full <- rbind(NEO_full, removed_pops, backingfile = "../data/intermediate/rbind_data/NEO_full_clean")
```

# Impute

```{r}
NEO_full <- gt_impute_simple(NEO_full, method = "mean")
```

# LD clumping

```{r}
to_keep_LD <- loci_ld_clump(NEO_full,
  thr_r2 = 0.2, size = 100,
  return_id = TRUE, use_positions = TRUE
)
NEO_full_ld <- NEO_full %>% select_loci(all_of(to_keep_LD))
```

# Loci and sample count

```{r}
nrow(NEO_full_ld)
count_loci(NEO_full_ld)
```

# Group

```{r}
NEO_full_ld <- NEO_full_ld %>% group_by(population)
```

```{r}
NEO_full_ld <- gt_update_backingfile(NEO_full_ld, 
                                  "../data/intermediate/rbind_data/NEO_full_ld_clean")
```

# Fastmixture clustering

@TODO rerun fastmixture analysis with CV to choose K

```{r}
k <- c(10:25)
  qmats <- gt_fastmixture(NEO_full_ld,
    k,
    n_runs = 1,
    threads = 10,
    batches = 16,
    seed = c(1),
    no_freqs = TRUE
  )
saveRDS(qmats, "../data/intermediate/fastmixture/africa/fastmixture_test.RData")
```

```{r}
qmats <- readRDS("../data/intermediate/fastmixture/africa/fastmixture_test.RData")
head(qmats$group)
```

```{r}
qmats <- gt_admix_reorder_q(qmats)
```

# Using K = 10

```{r}
qmat_10 <- get_q_matrix(qmats, k = 10, run = 1)

tidy_q_10 <- tidy(qmat_10, data = NEO_full)

mean_per_pop_10 <- tidy_q_10 %>% 
  group_by(group, q) %>%
  reframe(mean_percentage = mean(percentage))

wide_data <- mean_per_pop_10 %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = q, values_from = mean_percentage, values_fill = 0) %>%
  # make all .Q columns numeric
  mutate(across(starts_with("Q"), as.numeric))

wide_data_no_group <- wide_data %>% select(-group)
```

## Recording R environment

Part of ensuring our workflow is reproducible is to keep track of the R environment.
We will automatically save our R environment into a file called `r_environment.json`.

```{r save-r-environment, echo=FALSE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
filename_rmd <- "s05_b_fastmixture_africa.Rmd"
filename_renv <- paste0(
  output_dir, "/renv_",
  tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(filename_rmd)),
  ".json"
)
renv::lockfile_write(renv::lockfile_create(), file = filename_renv)
print(sessionInfo())
```
